summary: RETEST of 2 bugs from iteration_11: (1) Checkout nested-form bug fixed — forgot-password AND quick-login now work inside the checkout page without submitting outer order form. (2) Favorites panel now refreshes immediately after removal from Dashboard. All 3 requested flows PASS.

issues: React hydration warning: <span> cannot be child of <option> in the wilaya <select> (checkout-wilaya). Caused by preview instrumentation wrapping dynamic text in a <span>. Non-blocking but noisy in console.

critical_code_review_comments: Checkout.jsx fix looks correct: inner <form>s replaced by <div>s and buttons are type='button' with explicit onClick={doForgot}/{doQuickLogin}. Note: doForgot/doQuickLogin still call e.preventDefault() but receive a click event — harmless since preventDefault exists on click events, just unnecessary.
Wilaya <option> renders raw dynamic text through preview instrumentation which injects a <span>; consider wrapping content differently or ignoring since it's dev-only preview noise.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Both iteration_11 bugs verified fixed. TEST1: /commande forgot-password shows checkout-reset-link-box (with checkout-reset-link-btn) without URL change. TEST2: /commande quick-login logs in, hides quick-login widget, pre-fills checkout-name and checkout-email with the customer's data, URL stays on /commande. TEST3: removing a favorite via product-card-fav-* inside favorites-panel makes the product disappear immediately (Dashboard re-fetch on favIds change works).
rca of the issue: Previously nested <form> elements were silently stripped by the browser, causing inner submit buttons to trigger the outer order form. Fix: converted inner login/forgot containers to <div> and switched buttons to type='button' with onClick handlers. Favorites panel bug fixed via useEffect refetch of /favorites when favIds change in useFavorites context.
